answer_1.quote: We present a continuous-valued token based language modeling approach for zero-shot text-to-speech synthesis, thereby eliminating the use of vector quantization.

answer_2.quote: To assess robustness and intelligibility, we perform ASR on synthesized speech using both a Conformer-Transducer model and HuBERT-Large ASR model. We calculate WER between the transcripts and the ground truth text.

answer_4.quote: We conducted subjective evaluations using a crowdsource human rating system to assess MOS, SMOS, and CMOS, which correspond to overall speech quality, speaker similarity, and naturalness of the synthesized speech, respectively.
answer_4.guideline: For MOS and SMOS evaluations, each test sample is rated on a scale from 1 to 5, in increments of 0.5 points. For the CMOS evaluation, the ground truth sample and the generated sample are presented in random order to the participants, who assign scores from -3 (much worse than the baseline) to 3 (much better than the baseline), with intervals of 1.
